description: A series of mysterious thefts have plagued the coastal town of Nice, France. As the sun sets, shadows dance along the Promenade des Anglais, where whispers of a notorious thief linger. Your mission is to uncover the identity of the elusive suspect before they vanish into the night. Follow the clues hidden in the conversations of locals and the artifacts left behind, but beware of the misdirections that may lead you astray.

reasoning_chain: Clara Dubois is the only suspect with a red scarf mentioned in Nice.
Her favorite food, éclairs, aligns with the gossip from Old Town.
The vintage scooter matches the vehicle description from Monaco.
No other suspect has all these traits combined.

solution: Connect the clues about the red scarf, éclairs, and vintage scooter to identify Clara Dubois as the thief.
